answer: An agent marketplace requires each seller to lock a separate bond for 30 days before accepting jobs; a verifiable breach of the job contract forfeits that bond. Whether agents sell mesa maps, lagoon surveys, or quartz assays, the same rule applies. An attacker spawning 1,000 identities must fund 1,000 bonds and keep that capital idle. Discarding a caught identity cannot recover its forfeited stake, so repeated fraud consumes real money.
